description: This file defines the AdbSocket class, which manages adb socket connections, including opening sockets, handling messages, and communicating with the associated AdbDevice.

classes.name: AdbSocket
classes.description: Represents an adb socket, supporting multiple independent connections for executing adb commands.

methods.name: AdbSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket with a device and socket ID.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection to a destination.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming adb messages, updating socket state or processing data.

methods.name: sendReady
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment message to signal readiness.
